sources.title: Alibaba Unveils Qwen3.6-Plus to Accelerate Agentic AI Deployment for Enterprises and Alibaba’s AI Applications
sources.evidence: Dated April 2, 2026; explicitly announces Alibaba released Qwen3.6-Plus. Describes Qwen lineage, a default one-million-token context, agentic coding, document and video reasoning, and hosted access. Says selected Qwen3.6 models will be open-sourced, without identifying Plus as open-weight or explicitly proprietary.

sources.title: qwen3.6-plus — Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
sources.evidence: Re-fetched and parsed the full exact-model HTML on October 27, 2026 after browser extraction exceeded its size limit. It maps qwen3.6-plus to qwen3.6-plus-2026-04-02 and documents text/image/video input, text output, Function Calling and 1,000,000-token context. Neither alias nor snapshot section gives total/active parameter counts or a quantified named base. The hybrid-attention/MoE description is adjacent navigation for Qwen3.5-Plus, not this model.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Updated October 22, 2026. Regional release tables explicitly list qwen3.6-plus and its April 2 snapshot under April 1, 2026. This is the earliest documented public availability found, preceding the April 2 launch announcement.

sources.title: Text generation models
sources.evidence: Updated October 15, 2026. The exact qwen3.6-plus row lists 1M context and support for thinking mode, Function Calling, built-in tools and structured output. It is in the legacy models section.

sources.title: Key Concepts — Qwen
sources.evidence: The indexed documentation describes the Qwen Plus product line as proprietary, but predates Qwen3.6-Plus and does not identify this exact revision; insufficient alone to establish its current weight availability.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-Plus: Towards Real World Agents
sources.evidence: April 2, 2026 launch post reopened October 27. Describes improvements over the preceding Qwen3.5 deployment but does not identify Plus as a fine-tune or fixed-architecture variant of a quantified named checkpoint. Its language benchmark image (0360fb4a4c35c9bc6a83d8e29578e70202d7afc2.png) was visually inspected: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Qwen3.6-Plus are separate comparison columns, with no total or active-parameter row.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Agentic Coding Power, Now Open to All
sources.evidence: April 17, 2026 first-party release, checked October 27. Explicitly publishes 35B total and 3B active for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and names Qwen3.6-Flash as its API counterpart. Plus is mentioned as an earlier launch, not as an alias or derivative of this checkpoint. The language and vision comparison tables do not disclose Plus counts.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
sources.evidence: April 24, 2026 first-party release, checked October 27. Publishes 27B for a separately named dense multimodal checkpoint and 397B total/17B active for the Qwen3.5 comparator. Mentions the earlier Plus launch without identifying Plus as that 27B model or a variant of any quantified base.

sources.title: Qwen3.7-Plus: Multimodal Agent Intelligence
sources.evidence: June 3, 2026 later first-party comparison, checked October 27. Visually inspected both linked benchmark tables (817cdbe5b3bfd8649e492d3e03e7ab3ce98a37a8.png and 4bf3dfa024483ccbc02411ad9382c7544c3b0e21.png). They explicitly include Qwen3.6-Plus but report benchmark scores only, with no total or activated-parameter row. The article supplies no quantified base relationship for Qwen3.6-Plus.

sources.title: Official Qwen Qwen3.6 weight inventory
sources.evidence: The live query returned 4 repositories. The official Plus announcement offers hosted access and separately promises smaller open models. The current Qwen3.6 weight inventory contains 27B and 35B-A3B, not Plus.

name.note: Normalized display spacing corresponds to the official Qwen3.6-Plus name.

developer.note: Alibaba explicitly identifies itself as the releasing developer.

family.note: The announcement places this exact model in the Qwen series.

release_date.note: The official lifecycle tables explicitly record April 1 availability for the alias and snapshot across regional deployments. Use the earliest documented release; the April 2 public announcement and snapshot label do not establish that availability began later.

open_weights.note: The official Plus announcement offers hosted access and separately promises smaller open models. The current Qwen3.6 weight inventory contains 27B and 35B-A3B, not Plus. Classified closed under the public-download availability rule at review time; an explicit proprietary declaration is not required.

license.note: No exact-model weight license is disclosed in the accessed primary materials; do not borrow Apache-2.0 from separate open Qwen3.6 checkpoints.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no published nominal total or explicit lineage to a quantified base for this alias/snapshot. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B is a comparator; 35B-A3B is explicitly linked to Flash, and 27B is separately released. General succession from Qwen3.5 does not establish unchanged structure or justify inheriting its size.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count was found for Plus in the exact card, release evidence or later Qwen3.7-Plus comparison tables. The published 3B active count identifies Flash/35B-A3B; the 17B figure identifies the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B comparator. Neither transfers to Plus.

architecture.note: No exact-model architecture is disclosed. The card includes adjacent-page architecture text for Qwen3.5-Plus, which does not establish Qwen3.6-Plus architecture.

context_window.note: Exact card specifies 1,000,000 tokens for the snapshot and maps the alias to it; text-generation table independently lists 1M. This is documented capacity, not an endpoint execution test.

modalities.note: Exact alias card explicitly lists these input and output modalities.

reasoning.note: The exact alias row explicitly supports thinking mode.

tool_call.note: The exact alias card and text-generation row explicitly support Function Calling.

description.value: Alibaba Qwen model for agentic coding and multimodal understanding, with a one-million-token context window.
description.note: Replaces the vague workhorse description with supported tasks and context capacity.

patch.description: Alibaba Qwen model for agentic coding and multimodal understanding, with a one-million-token context window.
patch.notes: Model Studio records April 1, 2026 availability, preceding the April 2 launch announcement. The alias maps to qwen3.6-plus-2026-04-02. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed, with no established lineage to a quantified base; the published 35B/3B figures identify the separate Flash/35B-A3B model. Architecture and weight license are undisclosed. No public Plus weight release is available. Classified as closed weights: no public release of this hosted variant was found in the developer documentation and weight inventory.
